title: Surreal Time Fairy
description: A woman with large iridescent green butterfly wings stands at the center of a surreal dreamscape. She wears a golden scaled bodysuit with flowing green vines, a crown of colorful flowers, and is surrounded by melting clocks, golden hands emerging from water, glowing jellyfish, a futuristic city, and a cosmic sky filled with floating eyeballs and swirling galaxies.
prompt: A beautiful woman with long wavy brown hair and large translucent green butterfly wings stands in the center of a surreal landscape. She wears a form-fitting golden metallic bodysuit covered in green vines and a crown of vibrant red, purple, and yellow flowers. Melting clocks drip from dead trees and stone platforms, giant golden hands rise from glowing blue water filled with jellyfish, while a futuristic neon city appears in the background under a swirling cosmic sky with floating eyeballs and galaxies.
